blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The cancellation of a planned class suspension in Pavia, Iloilo, and differing decisions among local governments in Iloilo have raised questions over whether mayors have the legal authority to suspend classes solely for National Teachers’ Day on Monday. Pavia initially announced the suspension of classes and school-based work in public and private schools from preschool to senior high school, citing the need to recognize teachers and education workers. The municipal government later withdrew the order after reviewing its legal basis.
